about: Hand-written rotation guides for the priest's player pages (guides.py).

raid.plan: Shadow in a raid keeps **Shadow Word: Pain** on the boss, casts **Devouring Plague**, **Shadow Word: Death** and **Mind Blast** each time they come off cooldown, and channels **Mind Flay** in every gap. **Shadowform** goes up before the pull and stays up all fight.
why: **Shadowform** is what makes the spec work: 10% more Shadow damage, half the mana cost on every Shadow spell and a doubled critical strike bonus. You cannot cast heals while in it.

**Shadow Word: Pain** is first because it does about a fifth of your damage for one global cooldown every 24 seconds (18, plus 6 from **Improved Shadow Word: Pain**). Recast it only after it falls off, and not in the last 10 seconds of the fight, when a new one gets only a few ticks.

**Inner Focus** makes your next spell free, and the list spends it on **Devouring Plague** at the pull (it comes back every 3 minutes, so once in a 3-minute fight). Its 25% crit bonus does not apply to a damage-over-time spell (beta notes of 2026-10-01), so the pair only saves mana; it comes from the community simulator's own rotation.

After that, **Devouring Plague** goes out each time its 24-second cooldown ends, as soon as **Shadow Word: Death** and **Mind Blast** are both cooling down: its disease lasts 24 seconds, so it is up almost all fight (the simulator's 2.5% gain from casting it on cooldown was measured on the old 1-minute cooldown). **Devouring Contagion** halves its cost, and it heals you for the damage it deals.

**Shadow Word: Death** comes before **Mind Blast** because its cooldown is longer (15 seconds against 5.5 with **Improved Mind Blast**), so waiting costs it more; the simulator measured 0.4% more damage in this order. Below 20% of the boss's health, **Early Demise** adds 30% to its crit chance.

**Mind Flay** fills every gap and does almost half your damage: a 3-second channel that **Improved Mind Flay** makes 20% stronger. Every Shadow damage spell also stacks **Shadow Weaving** on the target (it takes 2% more Shadow damage from you a stack, up to 5, for 15 seconds), so while you keep casting it stays at 5 by itself.
caveats: **Shadow Word: Death** hits you for 10% of your maximum health every time the target survives it, about 11 times in a 3-minute fight. The damage numbers ignore that; your healers do not. **Devouring Plague** heals some of it back.

**Mind Blast** causes a lot of threat (its tooltip says so). In the first seconds of a fight or after a tank swap, hold it until the tank is ahead; **Silent Resolve** in this build cuts the threat of your spells by 30% (Shadow Affinity, which did the same for Shadow spells, is gone since client 70425).

When you must move, **Mind Flay** and **Mind Blast** stop: use your instants, **Shadow Word: Death**, **Devouring Plague** and **Shadow Word: Pain** if it fell off. **Shadow Weaving** drops after 15 seconds without a Shadow spell.
Mana is not your problem in a full raid: the simulator's priest never runs dry, with one mana potion and two Demonic Runes a fight.
diverge: With adds up, keep **Shadow Word: Pain** on the ones that live longest and put **Devouring Plague** on one that dies first: **Devouring Contagion** makes the plague jump to a nearby enemy when its target dies. The simulator fights one target, so this is not measured.
**Silence** is in this build but not in the list: use it to stop a casting add. It costs one global cooldown.

**Vampiric Embrace** has no line because the simulator counts only damage. If your group takes damage, cast it on the boss: for 30 seconds your party heals for 20% of your Shadow damage, for 40 mana and one global cooldown a minute.
If your healers struggle, save **Shadow Word: Death** for the last 20% of the boss's health, where **Early Demise** makes it crit more. You give up some damage to stop the backlash.

leveling.plan: Shadow levels on a short loop: your opening spells land while the mob runs in, **Mind Flay** slows and kills it, and **Shadow Word: Death** or your wand finishes it. **Shadowform** at 40 is the big step: the fight lab's time per kill drops from 36 to 22 seconds between levels 30 and 40.
why: Open from as far away as you can: the fight lab casts the instants first (**Vampiric Embrace** when it is ready, then **Shadow Word: Pain**) and **Mind Blast**, your biggest hit, right after, so all three land while the mob walks in.

**Mind Flay** (level 20) is your filler and your biggest damage share (about 45% at 60): it slows the mob while you channel, so a mob walking in reaches you later. **Mind Blast** goes out whenever it is ready.

From 32, **Shadow Word: Death** finishes. The fight lab casts it when one cast will kill the mob, so its backlash (10% of your health when the target survives) never lands, and below 20% health once you have **Early Demise** (level 35). From 40 it does a sixth to a quarter of your damage and the wand is rarely needed.
Before 20 your wand finishes: when a mob has a hit or two of wand damage left, a new spell would be wasted mana. **Mind Blast** also finishes a mob when one cast kills it.
**Vampiric Embrace** (level 28) is your heal once **Shadowform** stops real heals: it heals you for a fifth of your Shadow damage, and the fight lab casts it whenever it is ready.

Mana: **Spirit Tap** doubles your Spirit for 15 seconds after kills and **Shadowform** halves your Shadow costs, so the tuned rules (2026-10-20) drink only below 15% mana. They also skip the pre-pull **Power Word: Shield** unless you start a pull below 80% health (about 13% faster than shielding every pull: the shield is not a Shadow spell and costs full mana).
caveats: The tuned rules never cast **Devouring Plague** (about 11% faster without it): at top rank it costs 985 mana for 848 damage over 24 seconds, and most mobs die before it ends. Nor **Smite** (about 7% faster without it).

**Shadowform** blocks your heals but cuts the physical damage you take by 15%: from 40 your only healing in a fight is **Vampiric Embrace**, and between fights you eat (below about two thirds of your health) instead of casting **Renew**.
Two or three mobs at once: put **Shadow Word: Pain** on each and use **Psychic Scream** (below 40% of your health with a mob on you) to buy time. The no-shield rule was tuned on single pulls.
diverge: When a pull goes wrong (an add, a caster pack), shield yourself: **Power Word: Shield** absorbs damage and stops pushback on your casts while it holds.
Below 40% health with the mob on you: **Psychic Scream**, then **Flash Heal** if you are not in **Shadowform** yet.

raid.plan: Smite in a raid keeps two burns up, **Shadow Word: Pain** and **Holy Fire**, fires **Penance** whenever it is ready and casts **Smite** in every gap. **Holy Fire** counts for more than its own damage: with **Power in Light** your **Smite** and **Penance** deal 10% more while it burns.
why: **Holy Fire** starts 3 seconds before the pull (a 3-second cast with **Divine Fury**), so it lands as the fight begins. Recast it when its burn has about 1.5 seconds left, roughly every 12 seconds: the new one lands just after the old burn ends, and the simulator measured that 0.5% ahead of starting 3 seconds early.

**Penance** is on top: three Holy bolts in 2 seconds on a 12-second cooldown, about a quarter of your damage, and the simulator measured 3.1% more damage with it first. The full list casts rank 3 (from the community simulator's rotation): a little less damage than rank 4 for 30% less mana, and high enough that our downranking model leaves it its full spell power.
**Shadow Word: Pain** is about 30% of this build's damage for one global cooldown every 18 seconds. Recast it when it falls off, but not in the last 10 seconds of the fight.

**Inner Focus** goes into **Devouring Plague** to make it free (its 3-minute cooldown allows one in a 3-minute fight; the list's second **Inner Focus** line, into **Smite**, only comes up in longer fights); the simulator measured about 1% more damage with that pair. Paid for, the plague costs this build about 890 mana (no **Shadowform** or **Devouring Contagion** to cut it), and the simulator measured 2.0% more damage after dropping the plain **Devouring Plague** line.

**Shadow Word: Death** and **Power Infusion** go out on cooldown, then **Smite** fills everything else. **Mind Blast** is left out: none of your Holy talents help it and it costs more mana than **Smite**, and the simulator measured about 5% more damage casting **Smite** in its place.
caveats: This build runs short of mana even in a full raid: the simulator's priest also uses two mana potions and two Demonic Runes a fight. **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, and the cheaper ranks the full list picks (rank 3 **Penance**, rank 3 **Shadow Word: Death**, the latter measured 0.5% better than rank 4) are part of the mana plan; neither is far enough below your level to lose spell power in our downranking model.

The full list still holds a rank 2 **Smite** for 20-50% mana, measured before 2026-10-09; it now sits under the top-rank **Smite** and never fires. Ranks far below your level get much less from your spell power (a beta change; our model leaves rank 2 a small fraction of it), so do not downrank **Smite**.
**Shadow Word: Death** hits you for 10% of your maximum health each time the boss survives it, about 10 times a fight: your healers pay for that.
The full list also holds **Mind Blast**, **Shadowform** and **Mind Flay** lines below the unconditional **Smite**: they never fire for this build.
diverge: When the boss has under 3 seconds to live, cast **Smite** (2 seconds) rather than a new **Holy Fire** (3 seconds): only a spell that finishes casting does damage.
If healing is tight, cast **Shadow Word: Death** only in the last 20% of the boss's health, as the simulator's rotation for fighting alone does. You give up a little damage.
When you must move, use the instants: **Shadow Word: Death**, and **Shadow Word: Pain** if it fell off. **Holy Fire**, **Smite** and **Penance** all need you to stand still.

leveling.plan: Leveling as Smite: pull with the instant **Shadow Word: Pain**, cast **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready and **Smite** while the mob has more than 35% of its health, both only above 30% of your mana, and let your wand do the rest. A **Power Word: Shield** before every pull lets you keep casting in melee.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** pulls because it is instant and ticks for the whole fight; **Improved Shadow Word: Pain** (levels 59-60) makes it last longer. **Power in Light** (17-19 and 33) adds 8% to **Smite** while it burns.
**Mind Blast** hits hardest for its mana, so it goes first whenever ready (above 30% mana and while the mob has more than 20% of its health).
**Smite** only while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% mana: below that your wand finishes without spending mana or starting a cast the mob may not live through.

Mana sets the pace. The tuned rules (2026-10-20) cast **Smite** and **Mind Blast** only above 30% of your mana and drink only below 15%: between the two you only wand while your mana creeps back, so most fights end on the wand (about half the damage at 60 in the fight lab). That is why **Wand Specialization** (levels 10-11) and **Spirit Tap** (35-39) are the build's most valuable talents in the fight lab at 60, with **Meditation** (half your regeneration while casting).
**Inner Focus** at the start of a pull, whenever it is ready: press it right before **Mind Blast** to make that cast free with 25% more crit chance.
caveats: The pre-pull shield is part of this rotation: **Smite** takes 2 seconds or more to cast, and while **Power Word: Shield** holds, damage does not push your casts back. In melee, shield again once Weakened Soul is gone and you are below 80% health.
The tuned rules never cast Holy Fire or Devouring Plague: per point of mana they deal less than **Mind Blast**. This build has no **Penance**.
This build has no area damage: pull one mob at a time. With two on you, **Psychic Scream** sends them running.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you.
For pure speed, level as Shadow: about 25 seconds per kill in the fight lab (level-weighted) against this build's 35.

raid.plan: The healer lab's Holy priest heals the tank with **Penance** every time it is ready and with **Greater Heal** downranked to the damage he has taken, heals the rest of the group only once they drop below 60% health (**Prayer of Healing** when two or more are that low), and keeps **Power Word: Shield** and **Flash Heal** for emergencies. Mana is the limit: even so, the lab's Holy priest spends part of its five-minute fight out of mana.
why: **Penance** goes on the tank whenever it comes off cooldown and he is missing most of what it heals. Since 2026-10-08 it heals more per mana than **Heal** and **Greater Heal**, and the healer lab measured about 6% more capacity than keeping it for emergencies.

**Greater Heal** is still your biggest heal. Start it on the tank when he is missing about half of what it heals and a boss swing is coming, at the lowest rank that covers what he is missing: the rest of a bigger rank would be overheal.

**Prayer of Healing** when two or more of your group are below 60% health (the class's tuned heal policy since 2026-10-21: two, not three, and 60%, not 70%); one hurt member below 60% gets **Renew** or a **Flash Heal**. In Forever **Prayer of Healing** heals the target and the target's party, so aim it at the group that is hurt.

**Renew** goes on the tank once he is missing a fifth of his health (the tuned policy, rather than a tenth), and on a raid member below 60% before a direct heal. It can crit since the beta's 2026-10-08 build.

**Inner Focus** goes on a full-rank **Greater Heal** when the tank is missing more than half of one: the heal is free and 25% more likely to crit, and a critical heal gives the tank 25% more armor for 15 seconds through **Inspiration**.

In an emergency (anyone below 20% health): **Power Word: Shield** on the tank if Weakened Soul is gone, then **Penance** if it is ready, then a full-rank **Flash Heal**. That threshold is the class's tuned heal policy (the default was 35%).
caveats: Mana runs out before healing power does: **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, and **Improved Healing** makes **Greater Heal** and **Penance** 15% cheaper. The tuned policy takes a mana potion below 40% of your mana.
This build has no **Prayer of Mending** (it needs 31 points in Holy). **Soul Warding**, where the build takes it, removes the shield's 4-second cooldown.

Ranks far below your level now get less from your healing power (a beta change; the formula is our assumption). In our model **Greater Heal** ranks 3 to 5 lose nothing and rank 1 about 15%, so downranking within **Greater Heal** still pays.
The lab is one healer keeping a tank and four players alive for five minutes. It does not model movement, dispels or other healers.
diverge: **Litany of Light** gives back 10% of a heal's base cost when it differs from your previous heal, so when two heals fit equally well, alternate them.
**Holy Nova** heals everyone around you; the lab never casts it, so use it only when your group stands together and is hurt.

leveling.plan: You level with your raid talents, Discipline first: the Holy talents from 31 on mostly heal. The fight is a Smite priest's: an instant pull with **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Mind Blast** on cooldown, **Smite** in between, both only above 30% of your mana, and your wand for the rest.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** pulls because it is instant and ticks for the whole fight. **Mind Blast** hits hardest for its mana, so it goes out whenever ready while you have more than 30% mana and the mob more than 20% of its health.
**Smite** only while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% mana: below that your wand finishes without spending mana.

Mana sets the pace. The tuned rules (2026-10-20) cast **Smite** and **Mind Blast** only above 30% of your mana and drink only below 15%: between the two you only wand while your mana creeps back, so most fights end on the wand (about half the damage at 60 in the fight lab).
**Inner Focus** (level 24) at the start of a pull: press it right before **Mind Blast** to make that cast free with 25% more crit chance.
After a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk on; eat only if you are still below two thirds of your health.
caveats: **Penance** (level 30) is in the build for the raid, but the tuned rules never cast it while leveling: it deals less per mana than **Mind Blast**, and casting it above 30% mana measured about 0.5% slower (at level 40 it took **Mind Blast**'s mana). The same goes for Holy Fire and Devouring Plague.

Most of your Holy points are for healing (**Spiritual Guidance**, **Spiritual Healing**, **Improved Renew**, **Litany of Light**), so this is a slow way to level: about 44 seconds per kill in the fight lab (level-weighted), against 25 for Shadow.
The pre-pull **Power Word: Shield** is part of this rotation: while it holds, damage does not push your **Smite** back. In melee, shield again once Weakened Soul is gone and you are below 80% health.
**Holy Nova** (level 42) is for pulls of several mobs: the fight lab casts it only when two or more are in reach.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
If you only want to reach 60, level as Shadow and respec.

raid.plan: The healer lab plays Discipline with the class's heal choices: **Penance** on the tank whenever it is ready, downranked **Greater Heal** on the tank, **Prayer of Healing** when the group drops below 60%, and **Power Word: Shield** and **Flash Heal** for emergencies. **Divine Aegis** and **Soul Warding** are what the deep Discipline points buy here; this build takes neither **Power Infusion** nor **Renewed Hope**.
why: **Penance** goes on the tank whenever it comes off cooldown and he is missing most of what it heals. Since 2026-10-08 it heals more per mana than **Heal** and **Greater Heal**, and the healer lab measured about 4% more capacity than keeping it for emergencies.
**Greater Heal** on the tank is your biggest heal. Start it when he is missing about half of what it heals and a boss swing is coming, at the lowest rank that covers the damage.

In an emergency (anyone below 20% health): **Power Word: Shield** on the tank if Weakened Soul is gone, then **Penance** if it is ready, then a full-rank **Flash Heal**. **Soul Warding** removes the shield's 4-second cooldown and cuts its cost by 15%.
Each critical direct heal leaves an absorb of 15% of the heal on the target (**Divine Aegis**, at most 1,200) and gives him 25% more armor for 15 seconds (**Inspiration**).

**Inner Focus** on a full-rank **Greater Heal** when the tank is missing more than half of one; **Prayer of Healing** when two or more of the group drop below 60% (the tuned policy since 2026-10-21; it was 70%); **Renew** on the tank once he is missing a fifth of his health.
caveats: Mana runs out first. **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast; the tuned policy takes a mana potion below 40% of your mana.
The lab shields only in emergencies: shielding the tank every time Weakened Soul ends measured slightly worse there, because the shields cost mana the fight runs short of.

Ranks far below your level now get less from your healing power (a beta change; the formula is our assumption). In our model **Greater Heal** ranks 3 to 5 lose nothing, so downranking within **Greater Heal** still pays.
This build gives up **Power Infusion**, **Renewed Hope**, **Spiritual Guidance**, **Spiritual Healing** and **Prayer of Mending**; in the healer lab it holds about 9% less than the Holy page's build.
diverge: **Litany of Light** (1 point) gives back 5% of a heal's base cost when it differs from your previous heal: alternate heals when two fit equally well.
With mana to spare, shield the tank more often: the lab's shields only went out in emergencies because mana ran out first.

leveling.plan: You level with your raid talents, all Discipline first. The fight is a Smite priest's: an instant pull with **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Mind Blast** on cooldown, **Smite** in between, both only above 30% of your mana, and your wand for the rest.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** pulls because it is instant and ticks for the whole fight. **Mind Blast** hits hardest for its mana, so it goes out whenever ready while you have more than 30% mana and the mob more than 10% of its health.
**Smite** only while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% mana; below that your wand finishes.

Mana sets the pace. The tuned rules (2026-10-20) cast **Smite** and **Mind Blast** only above 30% of your mana and drink only below 15%: between the two you only wand while your mana creeps back, so most fights end on the wand (about half the damage at 60 in the fight lab). **Meditation** (levels 22-24) keeps half your regeneration going while you cast.
**Inner Focus** (level 26) at the start of a pull: press it right before **Mind Blast** to make that cast free with 25% more crit chance.
After a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk; eat only if you are still below two thirds of your health.
caveats: **Penance** (level 30) is in the build for the raid, but the tuned rules never cast it while leveling: it deals less per mana than **Mind Blast**, and casting it above 30% mana measured about 1% slower (at level 40 it took **Mind Blast**'s mana). The same goes for Holy Fire and Devouring Plague.
This is a slow way to level: about 43 seconds per kill in the fight lab (level-weighted), Shadow 25. The fight lab does not count **Divine Aegis** or **Inspiration**: they are raid talents.
This build takes no **Power Infusion** or **Renewed Hope**: skip the list's lines for them.

The pre-pull **Power Word: Shield** is part of this rotation: while it holds, damage does not push your **Smite** back, and **Soul Warding** (level 36) removes its 4-second cooldown and cuts its cost by 15%.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
If you only want to reach 60, level as Shadow and respec: well under half the time per kill in the fight lab.

leveling.plan: The Discipline-Shadow build plays the Discipline leveling list (a Smite priest's) with Shadow's damage talents behind it: an instant pull with **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Mind Blast** on cooldown, **Smite** in between, both only above 30% of your mana, your wand for the rest, a **Power Word: Shield** before every pull. Discipline comes first (levels 10-24), then **Spirit Tap** (25-29), then mostly Shadow.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** and **Mind Blast** are your Shadow spells, and the Shadow points make them hit harder: **Improved Shadow Word: Pain** (levels 39-40) makes the pain last longer, **Shadow Weaving** (41-43) and **Darkness** (57-60) add Shadow damage, and **Improved Mind Blast** (37-38) brings **Mind Blast** back sooner.

Mana sets the pace. The tuned rules (2026-10-20) cast **Smite** and **Mind Blast** only above 30% of your mana and drink only below 15%: between the two you only wand while your mana creeps back, so most fights end on the wand (about half the damage at 60 in the fight lab). The build pays for it: in the fight lab its most valuable talents at 60 are **Spirit Tap** (double Spirit for 15 seconds after a kill), **Wand Specialization** (levels 10-11), **Improved Shadow Word: Pain** and **Meditation** (half your regeneration while casting).
**Smite** only while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% mana; **Mind Blast** above 30% mana while the mob has more than 10% of its health.
**Inner Focus** (level 30) right before **Mind Blast** makes that cast free with 25% more crit chance.
caveats: This build takes neither **Penance**, **Power Infusion** nor **Renewed Hope**: skip those lines. The tuned rules never cast Holy Fire or Devouring Plague.

The Discipline list never casts **Mind Flay** or **Vampiric Embrace**: the build's **Mind Flay** and **Improved Mind Flay** points (54-56) only open the **Darkness** tier. The fight lab measured this build at about 34 seconds per kill (level-weighted), against 25 for the Shadow page.
Drink below 15% of your mana; after a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk, and you eat only below two thirds of your health.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
For speed, the Shadow page levels about a quarter faster per kill.

leveling.plan: The Holy-Shadow build plays the Holy leveling list (a Smite priest's) with points in all three trees: an instant pull with **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Mind Blast** on cooldown, **Smite** in between, both only above 30% of your mana, your wand for the rest, a **Power Word: Shield** before every pull.
why: The Shadow points make your two Shadow spells hit harder and your mana last: **Spirit Tap** (double Spirit for 15 seconds after a kill), **Improved Shadow Word: Pain**, **Improved Mind Blast** and **Shadow Weaving**.

**Smite** only while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% mana; **Mind Blast** above 30% mana while the mob has more than 20% of its health. **Divine Fury** cuts **Smite**'s cast time.

Mana sets the pace. The tuned rules (2026-10-20) cast **Smite** and **Mind Blast** only above 30% of your mana and drink only below 15%: between the two you only wand while your mana creeps back, so most fights end on the wand (about half the damage at 60 in the fight lab).
**Inner Focus** right before **Mind Blast** makes that cast free with 25% more crit chance.
caveats: This build takes no **Penance**. The tuned rules never cast Holy Fire or Devouring Plague: per point of mana they deal less than **Mind Blast**.
**Mind Flay** is in the build but the Holy list never casts it, so its point only counts toward the Shadow tiers. Shadow levels faster per kill.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
For speed, level as Shadow.
